column1: Luis Arraez leads the slate with steady contact skills and a strong track record of hitting safely in over 76% of games, bolstered by a favorable lefty matchup at home. Otto Lopez offers similar reliability atop Miami’s lineup, showing a consistent ability to reach base and also benefiting from a platoon edge. Elly De La Cruz and Matt Olson round out the top options, each drawing a soft matchup with a park boost, but Arraez’s consistency stands out for Beat The Streak picks.
